title: French Algerian Beef Tagine
description: A rich and flavorful French twist on the traditional North African dish, featuring tender beef and a blend of warm spices.
instructions: Heat oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high.
Brown beef in batches until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Remove browned beef from pot and set aside.
Soften onions in same pot over medium heat, about 5 minutes.
Add garlic, cumin, coriander, and paprika to pot and cook for 1 minute.
Add browned beef back to pot and stir in tagine spice mix.
Bring mixture to a simmer, then cover pot and transfer to oven.
Bake at 300°F for 2 1/2 hours, or until beef is tender.
Stir in pistachios and season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with additional pistachios if desired.
